user.title: Libre Wireless speaker
user.description: Enter the address of a speaker built on a Libre Wireless module (LUCI control port 7777).

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the speaker.

error.cannot_connect: The speaker does not answer on the LUCI port (7777).
error.no_mac: The speaker answers on LUCI but its MAC address could not be read (AirPlay and Google Cast did not respond).

abort.not_libre_device: This AirPlay device is not a Libre Wireless module.
